isolation: JCODE_HOME=lanes/jcode/.home + --socket <home>/jcode.sock; operator ~/.jcode untouched. jcode caches the MCP tools/list per home - clear the home after a Timmy MCP schema change.
model_route: OpenRouter via built-in openrouter provider (or a named profile: timmy-openrouter, spark2-nim); key from OPENROUTER_API_KEY
tool_schema_note: per-model strictness (schema.models): a strict provider (Gemini) rejects a tool schema with an array lacking items; lenient providers accept. jcode driving Timmy MCP works on BOTH after timmy_promo_apply.beats gained items (schema.compliance); one_shot measured on gemini-3.8-flash (strict) and grok-4.6 (lenient).

evidence: gemini-3.8-flash (strict) ok after the schema fix + cache clear
